units.source_text: 在伊东续弈以来，三天的对局里，黑从101到121，共下二十一手，

en.t: Since play resumed in Ito, over the three days of the match, Black played twenty-one moves in all, from move 101 to move 121,

units.source_text: 双方用时是黑十一小时四十八分，白仅用时一小时三十七分。

en.t: the time used by the two players was eleven hours and forty-eight minutes for Black, while White used only one hour and thirty-seven minutes.

units.source_text: 倘使是平常的棋，大竹七段只下十一手就到时间了。

en.t: If this had been an ordinary game, Otake 7-dan would have run out of time after playing only eleven moves.
